top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a complete, independently confirmed discovery chain: Holst on GLP-1 secretion and incretin action, Mojsov on the active 7-36 peptide, Drucker on proglucagon-derived peptide biology. The clinical outcome evidence is mature, and the citation is scoped to the physiology and active form, not the drugs. The exclusion of Knudsen and the Mojsov-Habener priority question are real costs but attribution problems, not doubts about the science, so they do not justify no award.
